experiment.leakage_notes: Tasks are seeded regressions injected into real upstream repositories pinned at real commit SHAs. The adjudicating verifier is each repository's OWN upstream test suite, which was confirmed passing at the pinned SHA before any regression was injected (validity gate). No task text, fix, or test was generated from ONMC's implementation, so there is no train/test leakage from ONMC into the corpus. The injected regression is a single-function revert, so a passing verifier means the agent restored real upstream behaviour.

leakage_notes: Baseline validity gate run 2026-07-24: six/test_six.py 198 passed, tenacity/tests/test_utils.py 2 passed, attrs/tests/test_funcs.py 53 passed at the pinned SHAs. kennethreitz/records and chardet/chardet were EXCLUDED (unresolvable test-time dependencies: docopt/tablib, registry import error) rather than silently dropped. v2 adds three MULTI-SITE variants of the same three repositories because the v1 single-hunk tasks were measured to have a ceiling effect (both arms 9/9, delta 0.000): they could not discriminate between conditions. Each v2 prompt states the symptom and never the number of broken sites, so an agent that repairs the first failing assertion and stops does not pass. No task text, fix, or test is derived from ONMC's implementation. v3 scales to 29 tasks over SIX pinned upstream repositories (six, tenacity, attrs, jmespath.py, itsdangerous, python-slugify). The added tasks remove the BODY of a real upstream function via AST (replacing it with raise NotImplementedError) and are adjudicated by that repository's own tests, so the reference solution is genuine upstream code that predates ONMC entirely. Several tasks remove two or three related functions so the agent must find every affected site. No task text, fix, or test is derived from ONMC's implementation. Five candidate tasks were REJECTED by the vacuity gate (the removal left the adjudicating suite green) and are recorded in `excluded_tasks` with reasons rather than silently dropped. python-slugify needs text-unidecode at test time; that was discovered by the pristine gate and recorded in REPO_TEST_DEPS.

tasks.prompt: A regression was introduced in six.py: the PY2/PY3 integer_types definition is wrong. Fix six.py so the full upstream test suite in test_six.py passes again. Do not edit or delete any test.
tasks.expected_outcome: test_six.py passes (198 passed, 2 skipped) with the upstream integer_types behaviour restored and no test modified.

tasks.prompt: A regression was introduced in tenacity/_utils.py: find_ordinal returns incorrect suffixes. Fix tenacity/_utils.py so tests/test_utils.py passes again. Do not edit or delete any test.
tasks.expected_outcome: tests/test_utils.py passes with correct ordinal suffixes restored and no test modified.

tasks.prompt: A regression was introduced in src/attr/_funcs.py: asdict no longer applies its `filter` argument, so filtered attributes are incorrectly included. Fix src/attr/_funcs.py so tests/test_funcs.py passes again. Do not edit or delete any test.
tasks.expected_outcome: tests/test_funcs.py passes with upstream asdict filter behaviour restored and no test modified.
